I added `invoice_total(amounts)` and its test. `python -m pytest -q` passes: 3 tests, including the new one.

- **`invoices/__init__.py`** makes `invoices` a package.
- **`invoices/total.py`** defines `invoice_total`, which returns `sum(charge(amount) for amount in amounts)`. Each dollar amount goes through `payments.charge.charge`, so the result is in cents. `invoice_total([5, 10])` returns 1500.
- **`tests/test_invoices.py`** asserts `invoice_total([5, 10]) == 1500`.

I didn't commit anything; the changes are in the working tree on `s4/task-b`.
